notes:
Rename to Kairos; auto-save settings; compile with Nuitka; build in public repo

- Rename the app and package from Moment to Kairos, migrating Moment installs
  and publishing a bridge release to moment-releases.
- Settings save as soon as a control changes; the Save button is gone.
- tools/build.py compiles the kairos package to a native module with Nuitka
  before PyInstaller bundles it, so no Python source or bytecode ships.
- Builds run in the public kairos-releases repo (tools/public-build.yml);
  this repo's workflow only triggers them.
